article.headline: Peterson's 22 lead East Tennessee State past Samford 66-59
article.description: — Quimari Peterson had 22 points in East Tennessee State's 66-59 victory against Samford on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Peterson's 22 lead East Tennessee State past Samford 66-59
article.story: JOHNSON CITY, Tenn. -- — Quimari Peterson had 22 points in East Tennessee State's 66-59 victory against Samford on Saturday night. Peterson added seven rebounds and six steals for the Buccaneers (15-10, 8-4 Southern Conference). Maki Johnson scored 18 points and added nine rebounds. Karon Boyd shot 3 of 4 from the field and 8 for 10 from the line to finish with 14 points. Jaden Brownell led the way for the Bulldogs (19-6, 9-3) with 18 points and six rebounds. Rylan Jones added 15 points, six rebounds and two steals for Samford. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
